column1: # manifest_reuse_allowlist.tsv -- probes whose PASS in this walk's full pass may be REUSED by the cut-manifest replay
# (scripts/verify_cut_manifest.py, _live_reuse). Everything NOT listed here is measured AGAIN at manifest time, because a
# full-pass PASS is not a PASS at manifest time (v1.0.89: the graph and vector store diverged by 44 between the two).
# Matching walk id / box / installed version proves the same walk, not the same state, so this list is the only door.
# A probe belongs here ONLY if its subject cannot change after the install finishes. Anything touching stores, people,
# contacts, ingest, the assistant, briefs, latency or egress RE-RUNS, explicitly including people_stores_reconcile,
# image_pulls_match_pins is deliberately NOT here: it checks the digests the box pulled and RUNS, and a container restart
# or compose pull changes the running image (runtime state, not the pin file).
